title: You’re Progressing WRONG in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: BiggySweats
chapters: What You Should Be Doing Next
description:
Trying to figure out what you should actually be doing first in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0?

This guide breaks down the early progression route, including how Power Level works, why armour matters so much, when to upgrade your tools, what skills are actually worth focusing on, and how Vaults and Lodestones fit into your progression.

If you’ve started Dragonwilds and feel like there are loads of things you could be doing but no obvious order to follow, this gives you a simple route to keep moving forward without wasting time on the wrong stuff.
